parameters.name: ApplicationIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the excessive device registration applications.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 10,000.

parameters.name: Department
parameters.description: The user's department. The value must be 1 to 128 characters long and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), hyphens (-), underscores (\_), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), and spaces.

parameters.name: DeviceTag
parameters.description:
The device ID. You can get the device ID from the `DeviceTag` parameter returned by the following operations:

- [GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~): Queries the details of a user's device.

- [ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): Queries a list of devices for a user.

parameters.name: Hostname
parameters.description: The hostname of the device. The value must be 1 to 128 characters long and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), hyphens (-), underscores (\_), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), and spaces. If you specify only an underscore (\_), the query is extended to include devices whose hostnames contain 4-byte UTF-8 characters.

parameters.name: Mac
parameters.description: The MAC address of the device.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries on each page. Valid values: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: SaseUserId
parameters.description:
The user ID. You can get the user ID from the `SaseUserId` parameter returned by the following operations:

- [GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~): Queries the details of a user's device.

- [ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): Queries a list of devices for a user.

parameters.name: Statuses
parameters.description: The statuses of excessive device registration applications.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: The username. The value must be 1 to 128 characters long and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), hyphens (-), asterisks (\*), at signs (@), and spaces.
